description: Pinned Rust development tools for packages/octocode-native. `node skills-dev/octocode-dev/scripts/dev.mjs rust:tools` compares this file with what is installed and prints the install command of anything missing or different; nothing installs automatically. Tasks: skills-dev/octocode-dev/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#rust-dev-tools.

nightly.install: rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-20 --profile minimal --component miri,rust-src,llvm-tools

tools.name: cargo-sweep
tools.use: target/ cleanup after a toolchain bump

tools.name: cargo-machete
tools.use: optional: unused-dependency cross-check (shear is the gate)

tools.name: cargo-udeps
tools.use: optional: unused-dependency cross-check (needs nightly; shear is the gate)

runs.why: KeyedFlight: the ManuallyDrop release inside the map lock and the transient-key forget, across real threads; many seeds explore interleavings
UTF-8/UTF-16 offset math and checkpoint slicing (LineIndex)

unsupported: tokio IO driver (#[tokio::test], enable_all): foreign function `kqueue` on macOS; the async flight tests stay out
FFI: libc kill/poll/ioctl/mkfifo/clock_gettime, Windows NT calls, N-API: process, file-handle and addon code stay out
C libraries (tree-sitter grammars, PCRE2): any test that parses or searches stays out
Wall-clock budgets: a_minified_single_line_stays_linear asserts elapsed time

Interpretation cost: checkpointed_columns_match_a_naive_scan_everywhere (a quadratic naive scan over 40 KB) and the proptests (256 cases; isolation hides PROPTEST_CASES, and proptest calls getcwd) outlast the deadline; the fuzz target covers the same conversions
